name: Electro Arms -Realize Digital Dimension-
source:
The 3rd project from the team that brought us [url=http://vndb.org/v5843]Vermilion -Bind of Blood-[/url] and [url=http://vndb.org/v9981]Zero Infinity -Devil of Maxwell-[/url]. Unlike the previous titles, this one utilizes the E-mote sprite animation system.

There’s an urban legend that one can attain superpowers if they start up an app under moonlight while facing Roppongi Hills. While it’s an unfounded rumour, there indeed exists an application called “Electro Carrier”, distributed by the huge company Igel, which accesses the life-changing MMORPG “Electro Arms” upon proper start-up. The world transforms into a virtual one using the new system ‘Realize’, with floating monolith dungeons to explore, and an arena for players to battle, and each player is bestowed various ‘arms’. Reiji was delighted in this unrealistic scene and wished to make his shitty life into an interesting one. But is there a hidden motive behind Electro Arms?

[Edited from [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/11/01/november-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是制作[url=http://vndb.org/v5843]《Vermilion -Bind of Blood-》[/url]和[url=http://vndb.org/v9981]《Zero Infinity -Devil of Maxwell-》[/url]的团队推出的第三个项目。

与前作不同，本作采用了 E-mote 精灵动画系统。

有一个都市传说：面向六本木新城，在月光下启动某个应用程序，就能获得超能力。虽然这只是没有根据的传闻，但大型企业 Igel 确实发行了一款名为“Electro Carrier”的应用程序。正确启动后，它可以连接到改变人生的 MMORPG《Electro Arms》。

借助新系统“Realize”，世界变成了虚拟空间：这里有漂浮的巨石迷宫可供探索，也有玩家互相战斗的竞技场，每位玩家还会获得不同的“武装”。

玲司对这个不真实的场景感到兴奋，希望让糟糕的人生变得有趣。

但《Electro Arms》的背后，是否隐藏着某种动机？

[改编自 [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/11/01/november-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
